modules.title: Getting Started
modules.content:
## How to Install

To download the Synergy Hockey Application, click [here,](https://www.synergysportstech.com/apps/hockey/client/production) or copy and paste the address into the URL bar: <https://www.synergysportstech.com/apps/hockey/client/production>

### For PC users:

The install screen will be as follows:

![Screenshot: How to Install](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565974-01.jpg)

Click **Install.**

![Screenshot: How to Install](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565974-02.jpg)

After installing the program will open and prompt you to log in.

![Screenshot: How to Install](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565974-03.jpg)

### For Mac users:

To download the Synergy Hockey Application, click [here,](https://www.synergysportstech.com/apps/hockey/client/production) or copy and paste the address into the URL bar: <https://www.synergysportstech.com/apps/hockey/client/production>

![Screenshot: How to Install](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565974-04.jpg)

1. Select **Download**

2. Once downloaded, open the DMG file and drag the Synergy Hockey App icon into the Applications folder icon. This step is necessary to receive notifications for future updates

![Screenshot: How to Install](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565974-05.jpg)

3. From the Applications folder, open the Synergy Hockey App. If prompted, click **Open** for any message asking you to confirm that you want to open Synergy Hockey App.

4. After installing, open the app from your application folder.  The program will prompt you to log in.

![Screenshot: How to Install](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565974-06.jpg)

## Minimum and Recommended Requirements

### Minimum Requirements

Synergy requires the following *minimum* specifications to run the Synergy Hockey application.

#### Mac

- macOS 10.15 Catalina or higher
- Intel quad-core i3 processor or greater
  - At least 3GHz
  - supported processor architecture: x86, x64 (ARM is not supported)
- 8 GB RAM or greater
- 512 GB or greater hard disk storage
- Discrete graphics card

#### Windows

- Windows 10 (64-bit)
- Intel dual-core i3 processor or greater
  - At least 3GHz
  - supported processor architecture: x86, x64 (ARM is not supported)
- 8 GB RAM or greater
- 512 GB or greater hard disk storage
- Discrete graphics card

> **Note**: Multi-core i3 devices that meet the requirements above will support basic functionality.

If you are upgrading or purchasing a new computer, please see the recommended requirements below.

###

### Recommended

Synergy recommends the following specifications for running most Synergy applications, including the Basketball app. If you are purchasing a new Mac computer, a quad-core processor and a discrete graphics card are essential; for Windows, a multi-core processor is essential. Increased RAM, at or greater than the recommended configuration below, and sufficient hard disk space or video backup storage, are the next most important options to consider for capture and editing workflows.

#### Mac

- macOS 11 Big Sur or higher
- Intel quad-core i7 processor or greater
  - At least 2.3 GHz before Turbo Boost
- 16 GB RAM or greater
- 512 GB or greater hard disk storage
- Discrete graphics card

#### Windows

- Windows 11
- Intel quad-core i7 CPU or greater
  - At least 2.5 GHz before Turbo Boost
  - Supported processor architecture: x86, x64 (ARM is not supported)
- 16 GB RAM or greater
- 512 GB or greater hard disk storage
- Discrete graphics card

> Note: AMD processors, equivalent to the quad-core Intel i7, should also provide good performance.

## How to Log In

The Synergy Hockey app login page provides several security improvements for the storage of user credentials. When logging in to the Synergy Hockey app for the first time, follow the instructions below:

- Click to check the **Remember Me** box in the app to store credentials for future use.
- Select the **Click Here to** **log in** button in the app to launch the web browser.
- Enter your username & password in the web browser.
- Select the **Login** button in the web browser to automatically return to the app.
- For future use, the app will automatically login if Remember Me is selected.

Once logged in, you will be directed to the Single Game view by default. Here you can begin your session or use the options in the upper right to select a different view.

> Note: Subsequent logins will open to your last previous view

![Screenshot: How to Log In](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565976-01.jpg)

modules.title: Views, Controls and Video
modules.content:
## Views

Choose between Single Game View, Multi game View, Reports View, Player Search, or Saved Reports View when opening the app. Icons are located in the top right.

![Screenshot: Views](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565977-01.jpg)

Single Game View**:**Used to view data compiled from a single game and across a wide variety of unique filters.

 Multi game View: Used to view data compiled from multiple games and across a wide variety of unique filters.

 Reports View: Used to access Multi game Box Score data.

 Player View: Used for scouting purposes, search for players using physical attributes, and/or player stats across a wide variety of unique filters.

Saved Reports View**:**Used to access previously created and saved reports.

## Display Controls

When viewing shot charts, or other events, you may wish to focus on a specific area for a more detailed look. Using the display controls located below the Rink display, select an area of interest and view only the data from that selection, or omit an area from a selection. Additionally, you can zoom into the Rink display for a more detailed visual representation.

Display controls include:

**Select a Region**: Use to highlight an area of the rink which you would like to focus on. Click to select the button, then click and drag on the Rink display to draw a box around the area you would like to focus on.

![Screenshot: Display Controls](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565978-01.jpg)

**Deselect a Region**: Use to highlight an area of the rink which you would like to omit from your data. Click to select the button, then click and drag on the Rink display to draw a box around the area you would like to omit.

![Screenshot: Display Controls](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565978-02.jpg)

**Reset**: Used to reset any previous selections.

**Rink Zoom**: Use to choose from three levels of zoom for the Rink display: 1x, 2x, 3x.

![Screenshot: Display Controls](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565978-03.jpg)

**Enlarge**: Used to increase the size of all points on the Rink display, or points within a selected area.

**Play**: Used to access and play clips associated with a chart, individually selected items, or from a selected area. Will display the number of clips in an active selection below the icon.

## Playing Video

The **Playback/Editor**control is used to determine where the app will play or send the clips you select to view.

- **Playback**: Used to view clips within the Synergy Hockey App
- **Editor**: Used to send clips to the Synergy Editor application where they are available to view or use in Custom Edits

![Screenshot: Playing Video](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565979-01.jpg)

## Report Tabs

Create, work with, and save multiple charts or reports in the Hockey app using the Tab menu. Access the menu by clicking the carrot icon ( **^** )  located to the right in an active tab. Choose from the following options:

- Save
- Save As
- Export to PDF
- Add New Tab
- Rename
- Close

There is no limit to the number of tabs you can work within the Synergy Hockey app.

Additionally, use the PDF icon above the Report or Rink display to save your report as a PDF quickly.  This can be used in either Single or Multi Game views.

![Screenshot: Report Tabs](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565980-01.jpg)

modules.title: Single Game View: Filters and Tables
modules.content:
## Single Game View: Overview

Single Game View allows you to view data compiled from individual games and across a wide variety of unique filters.

The Single Game view provides an in-depth look at individual games and allows you to track shots, view stats, and compare lineups from a specific game. Select the **Single Game View** Icon in the upper right to begin working with this view.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Overview](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565981-01.jpg)

## Single Game View: Data Filters

To customize a Single Game view, use the filters located on the left-hand side of the application. Filters are dynamic and update the chart as they are selected. Some filters contain additional sub-filters to refine your search even further. Charts will include only that information that fits the filtered criteria.

- The filters section can be collapsed or expanded by selecting the vertical blue filters bar.
- Select the **Apply**button to create or update the chart.
- Select one or multiple values for each filter using the slider to view additional options.
- Use the **Select** **All** feature to activate all of the filters in a section or in the entire filter.
- Use the **Reset** option to clear the selections for an active filter.

#### Available Filters

Additional filters will be presented based on the Team selection, as well as varied by which view is active. For Single Game view, the filters are as follows:

- Game
- Player
- Action
  - Giveaway
  - Takeaway
  - Penalty
  - Hit
  - Attempt Blocked
- Strength
  - Even
  - PP (Power Play)
  - PK (Penalty Kill)
- Score
- Time (Range Filter)
- Shot Result
  - Goal
  - Shot on Goal
  - Blocked Shot
  - Missed Shot
- Shot Type
  - Wrist
  - Backhand
  - Snap
  - Deflected
  - Slap
  - Tip
  - Wrap Around
- Assisted By
- Linemates: On / Off Ice
- Opponents: On  / Off Ice

#### Range Filters

The following filters are Range Filters and are utilized differently

- Time

To apply these filters, use the slider to manually adjust the range within which you want to display.

####

## Single Game View: Game Selection Filter

The Game filter has drop-down menus to allow for the selection of a League, Season, Team, and Opponent. Choose the game you would like to focus on from the list below the filter. Once you've made your selections, click **Apply** to begin your report or cancel the process by selecting **Cancel**at the bottom of the panel. If you would like to reset your selections, use the **Reset**link located above the drop-down menus.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Game Selection Filter](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565983-01.jpg)

After selecting **Apply**to load the chart, the remaining filters will become available. The chart will dynamically update as filters are applied. Single Game defaults to the Box score view. Using the view selector in the upper left, choose between Event View (see the “Single Game View: Filters and Tables” lesson), Boxscore (see the “Single Game View: Filters and Tables” lesson), Faceoff (see the “Single Game View: Charts and Rink Displays” lesson), or Linemates (see the “Single Game View: Charts and Rink Displays” lesson).

## Single Game View: Box Score View

The default view for Single Game is the Box Score.  Here, you can view a variety of stats for a single game, or filter by period for a more detailed look. Export any data set to PDF by clicking the **PDF**icon above the chart and follow the prompts to save.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Box Score View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565984-01.jpg)

## Single Game View: Event View

Event View allows you to visualize the filtered data both on the rink and as an organized chart. Use the dropdown menu in the upper left to switch between Box Score, Event View, Faceoff, and Linemates views.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Event View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565985-01.jpg)

modules.title: Single Game View: Charts and Rink Displays
modules.content:
## Single Game View: Faceoff Chart

Similar to the Events Chart, the Faceoff view displays an interactive rink along with a data chart containing the associated data.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Faceoff Chart](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565986-01.jpg)

In this view, you're able to visualize Offensive, Defensive, and Neutral Zone Faceoff wins, losses, and totals related to the applied filters (if any).  Click on the chart to the right of the rink to view the clips associated with your selection.

## Single Game View: Linemates Display

Linemates uses the Rink, or Rink + Data to display each lineup from a single game. As with Event View, you can use the Event Type or Shot Type menu to filter the types of data presented, along with any additional filters applied from the Filter menu.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Linemates Display](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565987-01.jpg)

When using Rink + Data view,  the presentation will show the information displayed on the rink as well as in the chart.  You will see the Time on Ice for each lineup as well as any additional associated data.

Expanding the lineups will allow you to drill down deeper to better evaluate the effectiveness of a line or assess the dynamics of specific players in a given lineup in more detail.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Linemates Display](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565987-02.jpg)

While in Linemates, by switching the view below the Rink Display from All On Ice to Selected Players, you can select an individual line, or a group of lines by selecting the radio buttons next to any given line. The Rink Display will dynamically update to reflect the selected events for the selected lines only allowing you to drill down even further for specific data.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Linemates Display](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565987-03.jpg)

## Single Game View: Rink Display

The Rink display provides an interactive visualization of the filtered data.  Using the Display Controls located below the Rink display, you can perform a wide variety of functions to focus on and zoom in to an area and its associated data.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Rink Display](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565988-01.jpg)

**Display controls include:**

**Select Region**: Use to highlight an area of the rink which you would like to focus on. To use, click to select the button, then click and drag on the Rink display to draw a box around the area you would like to focus on.

**Deselect Region**: Use to highlight an area of the rink which you would like to omit from your data. To use, click to select the button, then click and drag on the Rink display to draw a box around the area you would like to omit.

**Reset**: Used to reset any previous selections.

**Rink Zoom**: Use to choose from three levels of zoom for the Rink display: 1x, 2x, 3x

**Enlarge**: Used to increase the size of all points on the Rink display, or points within a selected area.

**Play Selected Events**: Used to access and play clips associated with a chart, individually selected items, or from a selected area.

## Single Game View: Rink + Data Display

Selecting **Rink + Data** allows you to view the filtered data visually on the Rink as well as the associated Boxscore in a chart below the Rink. If a stat has an associated video, the number will appear in blue and will be selectable.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Rink + Data Display](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565989-01.jpg)

Selecting individual points from the Rink display will be reflected in the chart below to show only those items selected. Clicking on a blue number in the chart, or selecting the **Play**icon below the Rink display will open the video player and allow you to watch the associated clips.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Rink + Data Display](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565989-02.jpg)

## Single Game View: Event and Shot Type Menu

**Event Type** and **Shot Type** menus act as an interactive legend for the Rink display.  Each displays the color, shape, and type of points represented on the Rink Display along with additional filter settings. Click any menu item to toggle it on and off.  This will show or hide the item from view.

![Screenshot: Single Game View: Event and Shot Type Menu](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565990-01.jpg)
![Screenshot: Single Game View: Event and Shot Type Menu](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565990-02.jpg)

modules.title: Multi Game View
modules.content:
## Multi game View: Overview

This application combines unique analytical tools with our detailed and highly curated video to provide you with an invaluable team, coaching, and scouting asset.

Multi game View allows you to view data compiled from multiple games and across a wide variety of unique filters. The Multi game Shot Chart allows you to track shots and their respective locations on the ice over the course of an entire season. Use this tool to select specific parameters for what types of shots you want to see. Select the **Multi game View** icon in the upper right to begin working with this view.

![Screenshot: Multi game View: Overview](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565991-01.jpg)

## Multi game View: Data Filters

To customize a Multi game Shot Chart, use the filters located on the left-hand side of the application. Filters are dynamic and update the chart as they are selected.  Some filters contain additional sub-filters to refine your search even further. Charts will include only those shots which fit the filtered criteria and indicate the location of where each shot was taken on the ice.

- The filters section can be collapsed or expanded by selecting the vertical grey filters bar.
- Select the **Apply**button to create or update the chart.
- Select one or multiple values for each filter using the slider to view additional options.
- Use the **Select** **All** feature to activate all of the filters in a section or in the entire filter.
- Use the **Reset** option to clear the selections for an active filter.

**Available Filters**

Additional filters will be presented based on the **Team** selection, as well as varied by which view is active.  For Multi game View, the filters are as follows:

- **Team**
- **Player**
- **Game**
- **Action**
  - Giveaway
  - Takeaway
  - Penalty
  - Hit
  - Attempted Block
- **Strength**
  - Even
  - Power Play (PP)
  - Penalty Kill (PK)
- **Score**
- **Time**
- **Shot Result**
  - Goal
  - Shot on Goal
  - Blocked Shot
  - Missed Shot
- **Shot Type**
  - Wrist
  - Backhand
  - Snap
  - Deflected
  - Slap
  - Tip
  - Wrap Around
- **Assisted By**
- **Linemates: On/Off Ice**
- **Opponents: On/Off Ice**

#### Range Filters

The following filters are Range Filters and are utilized differently

- **Time**

To apply these filters, use the slider to manually adjust the range within which you want to display.

## Multi game View: Rink Display

Multi game shot charts open to the Rink display by default. This display provides an interactive visualization of the filtered data. Using the Display Controls located below the Rink display, you can perform a wide variety of functions to focus on and zoom in to an area and its associated data.

**Display controls include:**

**Area Select**: Use to highlight an area of the rink which you would like to focus on. To use, click to select the button, then click and drag on the Rink display to draw a box around the area you would like to focus on.

**Area Deselect**: Use to highlight an area of the rink which you would like to omit from your data. To use, click to select the button, then click and drag on the Rink display to draw a box around the area you would like to omit.

**Reset**: Used to reset any previous selections.

**Rink Zoom**: Use to choose from three levels of zoom for the Rink display: Full Ice, Zoom: 1x, 2x, and 3x.

**Enlarge**: Used to increase the size of all points on the Rink display, or points within a selected area

**Play Selected Events**: Used to access and play clips associated with a chart, individually selected items, or from a selected area.

## Multi game View: Rink + Data Display

Selecting **Rink + Data** allows you to view the filtered data visually on the Rink as well as the associated Boxscore in a chart below the Rink. If a stat has an associated video, the number will appear in blue and will be selectable.

![Screenshot: Multi game View: Rink + Data Display](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565994-01.jpg)

Selecting individual points from the Rink display will be reflected in the chart below to show only those items selected.  Clicking on a blue number in the chart or selecting the **Play** icon below the Rink display will open the video player and allow you to watch the associated clips.

![Screenshot: Multi game View: Rink + Data Display](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565994-02.jpg)

## Multi game View: Event and Shot Type Menu

Event Type and Shot Type menus act as an interactive legend for the Rink display. Each displays the color, shape, and type of points represented on the Rink Display along with additional filter settings. Click any menu item to toggle it on and off. This will show or hide the item from view. Use **Hide Legend/Show Legend**to toggle this display on and off.

![Screenshot: Multi game View: Event and Shot Type Menu](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565995-01.jpg)
![Screenshot: Multi game View: Event and Shot Type Menu](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565995-02.jpg)

## Multi game View: Faceoff Chart

Use the dropdown menu above the Rink display to switch between Event view and Faceoff view.

Similar to Event View, the Faceoff view displays an interactive rink along with a data chart containing the associated data.

![Screenshot: Multi game View: Faceoff Chart](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565996-01.jpg)

In this view, you're able to visualize Offensive, Defensive, and Neutral Zone Faceoff wins, losses, and totals related to the applied filters (if any). Click on the chart to view the clips associated with your selection.

## Multi game View: Generating A Shot Chart

The Team filter has drop-down menus to allow for the selection of a League, Season, and Team. Once you've made your selections, click **Apply** to begin your report or cancel the process by selecting **Cancel**at the bottom of the panel. If you would like to reset your selections, use the **Reset**link located above the drop-down menus.

![Screenshot: Multi game View: Generating A Shot Chart](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565997-01.jpg)

After selecting a league, season, and team, click **Apply**to load the chart. This will enable the additional filters. The chart will dynamically update as filters are applied. This view includes every shot taken by the selected team, including the location on the ice over the course of the selected season.

![Screenshot: Multi game View: Generating A Shot Chart](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565997-02.jpg)

modules.title: Reports View
modules.content:
## Reports View: Overview

Reports View allows you to view data, organized and detailed in a chart view, across a wide variety of unique filters.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Overview](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565998-01.jpg)

## Reports View: Data Filters

To customize a report, use the filters located on the left-hand side of the application. Filters are dynamic and update the chart as they are selected. Some filters contain additional sub-filters to refine your search even further. Charts will include only those items which fit the filtered criteria.

- The filters section can be collapsed or expanded by selecting the vertical grey filters bar.
- Select the **Apply**button to create or update the chart.
- Select one or multiple values for each filter using the slider to view additional options.
- Use the **Select** **All** feature to activate all of the filters in a section or in the entire filter.
- Use the **Reset** option to clear the selections for an active filter.

#### Available Filters

Additional filters will be presented based on the Team filter selection, as well as varied by which view is active. For Reports View, the filters are as follows:

- Game
- Player
- Action
  - Giveaway
  - Takeaway
  - Penalty
  - Hit
  - Attempt Blocked
- Strength
  - Even
  - Power Play (PP)
  - Penalty Kill (PK)
- Score
- Time
- Shot Result
  - Goal
  - Shot on Goal
  - Blocked Shot
  - Missed Shot
- Shot Type
  - Wrist
  - Backhand
  - Snap
  - Deflected
  - Slap
  - Tip
  - Wrap Around
- Assisted By
- Linemates: On/Off Ice
- Opponents: On/Off Ice

#### Range Filters

The following filters are Range Filters and are utilized differently

- Time

To apply these filters, use the slider to manually adjust the range within which you want to display.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Data Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565999-01.jpg)

## Reports View: Generating A Report

The Team filter has drop-down menus to allow for the selection of a League, Season, and Team. Once you've made your selections, click **Apply** to begin your report or cancel the process by selecting **Cancel**at the bottom of the panel. If you would like to reset your selections, use the **Reset**link located above the drop-down menus.

After selecting a league, season, and team, click **Apply**to load the chart. This will enable the additional filters. The chart will dynamically update as filters are applied.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Generating A Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566000-01.jpg)

## Reports View: Saving Reports

Create, work with, and save multiple charts or reports in the Hockey App using the Tab menu.  Access the menu by clicking the carrot icon ( **^** )  located to the right in an active tab.  Choose from the following options:

- **Save**
- **Save As**
- **Export to PDF**
- **Add New Tab**
- **Rename**
- **Close**

There is no limit to the number of tabs you can work within the Synergy Hockey app.

Additionally, use the PDF icon above the Rink display to quickly save your report as a PDF.  This can be done from either Single, Multi Game, or Reports view.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Saving Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566001-01.jpg)

Access previously saved reports or reports that have been shared with you from the **Saved Reports** view.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Saving Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566001-02.jpg)

Click to select a report from the list, then click the **Load**button to open the report.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Saving Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566001-03.jpg)

## Reports View: Sharing Reports

When you choose to save your report, you have the option to share it with other members of your organization.  Use the checkbox to select **I want to share this report with my team**. This will allow other users on your team to access your saved report.  Additionally, you can save or export your report as a PDF.

![Screenshot: Reports View: Sharing Reports](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566002-01.jpg)

modules.title: Player Search View
modules.content:
## Player Search View: Overview

This application combines unique analytical tools with our detailed and highly curated video to provide you with an invaluable team, coaching, and scouting asset.

Player Search View allows you to view player data compiled from multiple leagues and seasons across a wide variety of unique filters. The Single Player Search allows you to track shots, events, and their respective locations on the ice over the course of entire seasons, or multiple seasons. Use this tool to select specific parameters for what types of players you want to see. Select the **Player Search** icon in the upper right to begin working with this view.

![Screenshot: Player Search View: Overview](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566003-01.jpg)

## Player Search View: Data Filters

To customize a player search, use the filters located on the opening page of the Player Search view. Filters are dynamic and update the player list as they are selected. These filters can be used in conjunction with one another to drill down to the exact player, or players you are looking for. The player list will include all players who fit the filtered criteria and indicate their position, birth date, weight, height, team, and league.

#### Player Name

The Player Name search tool allows you to search for a specific players info by name.

**
![Screenshot: Player Search View: Data Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566004-01.jpg)**

#### Player Details

The Player Details search tool allows you to filter for players based on:

- League
- Season
- Team
- Shooting Hand
  - All
  - Left
  - Right
- Position
  - Goal
  - Defense
  - Forward
  - Center
  - Left Wing
  - Right Wing
  - Left Defense
  - Right Defense
- Age
- Weight (lb)
- Height (ft)

#### Range Filters

The following filters are Range Filters and are utilized differently:

- Age
- Weight (lb)
- Height (ft)

To apply these filters, use the slider to manually adjust the range within which you want to display. The range filters can also be set by entering a number into the boxes on either side if the slider.

#### Player Data

The Player Data search tool allows you to filter for players based on:

- Goals
- Assists
- Points
- Penalties
- Hits
- Shots
- Shot %
- Blocked Shots
- Giveaways
- Takeways
- Faceoffs Won

All player data filters are range filters, and function as described above by either adjusting the slider, or entering a number into the boxes on either side of the slider.

![Screenshot: Player Search View: Data Filters](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566004-02.jpg)

Once all of your desired filters have been set, a list of all players who match the criteria will be listed at the bottom of the app. To view reports based on the players, select the radio button next to their name(s) and a list of the selected players will be displayed in the bottom right of the app. Click **Apply**to generate reports on the selected player(s). Use the **Reset**button a the bottom right of the app at any time to clear all applied filters.

## Player Search View: Single Player

To begin using the single player view, select Single Player from the drop down at the top of the data table.

![Screenshot: Player Search View: Single Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566006-01.jpg)

A visual display will generate listing the players details and data, as well as an interactive rink display with the location of all events associated with the selected player.

![Screenshot: Player Search View: Single Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000566006-02.jpg)

This display provides an interactive visualization of the filtered data.  Using the Display Controls located below the Rink display, you can perform a wide variety of functions to focus on and zoom in to an area and its associated data.

**Display controls include:**

**Area Select**: Use to highlight an area of the rink which you would like to focus on. To use, click to select the button, then click and drag on the Rink display to draw a box around the area you would like to focus on.

**Area Deselect**: Use to highlight an area of the rink which you would like to omit from your data. To use, click to select the button, then click and drag on the Rink display to draw a box around the area you would like to omit.

**Reset**: Used to reset any previous selections.

**Rink Zoom**: Use to choose from three levels of zoom for the Rink display: Full Ice, Zoom: 1x, 2x, and 3x.

**Enlarge**: Used to increase the size of all points on the Rink display, or points within a selected area.

**Play Selected Events**: Used to access and play clips associated with a chart, individually selected items, or from a selected area.

This view also allows you to display the data in a Heatmap and a Zones view.
